reviews.comment: Lots of material covered in lectures. Supposed to do reading before each class, but it does not really matter. Homework is very quick and easy. Tests were online and open to all of her lectures on Canvas. She is very sweet and quiet, but the class can be awkward when nobody answers her questions/participates.

I took Dr. Kendall for 2 classes and can't say enough good things about her! She's very caring and always willing to work with students who are having a tough time. She's passionate about what she does and very clear about her expectations for assignments and exams. The only downside is she is soft-spoken so she can be tough to hear in-person.
She is hard to hear sometimes, but she is very passionate about what she teaches, and her homework assignments are helpful and usually short. I definitely recommend her class, even as an elective.

The unfortunate things about Dr. Kendall are that she is hard to hear so you're going to want to sit in the front and she does not generally respond to emails. She also might take a long time to get back to you on major assignments like the midterm. The upper-level language and gender class some a lot on progressive ideas of gender. Easy grader.

One of the most fascinating classes I've taken. Dr. Kendal is so so sweet and knowledgable and makes the class very interesting. Her tests are pretty straightforward and there is homework almost every night whether it's reading the textbook (she puts on ecampus) or an activity but they aren't too bad. would 100% take her again
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Prof Kendall is so nice! You have homework every night but at most takes maybe 45 minutes to do. She made 2/4 of our tests take home after we convinced her so I'm not sure if she will still do that for the future. But overall the tests weren't bad, she made a review powerpoint for all of them. Tons of extra credit! Take advantage of it!!
reviews.ratingTags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Prof Kendall is seriously so sweet! She made 2/4 of our tests take-home tests. You have homework every night but it takes less than 30 minutes to do usually. You get one free skip but after that it's points off you grade. She puts a lot of effort into her powerpoints and really wants to make sure you understand the material! 10/10 TAKE HER
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: I took Introduction to Linguistics with Dr. Kendall in the spring! She is an incredible professor and really cares about her students. She puts a lot of time and effort into the Powerpoints and lectures which makes them really interesting! The tests are pretty straightforward. She conducts a review so if you study you should be fine!
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: I can't say I knew a lot about linguistics before this class, but now I think I'm addicted. Dr. Kendall is a great prof who makes the subject matter really fun and really interesting. There's a fair amount of homework, but it's nothing too difficult, too long, and some of it can even be fun. Plenty of extra credit too.

This class was really interesting.  Dr. Kendall really tries to make the material fun and engaging and she usually succeeded. There were a lot of assignments but they were all very manageable. You get a lot of credit for coming to class so I'd recommend doing that. The tests are pretty detailed but she reviews you well and it should be an easy A.

Great class, really interesting. If you came to class, took notes, did the assigned readings (which were fairly short), and did the homework problems, you could easily make an A. She drops the lowest test grade and has plenty of extra credit opportunities. Plus, she makes linguistics fun and easy. I would definitely recommend this course! :)
